_note: What each free plan allows each model, as read on the service's own page (scripts/auto/llm.py: limits_of). 'models': the first pattern that matches a model's name gives its limits (rpm: calls a minute; rpd: calls a day; tpm: tokens a minute). We stop by ourselves at nine tenths of a day's calls. 'else': a model no pattern names (rpd 0: never asked, because what its free plan allows was not read). A service that is not here counts all its models together, by the cautious numbers in llm.py (OpenRouter's free models: 45 calls a day in all, and never a model whose name does not end in ':free': that rule is code, not this file).
